description: This Java class provides a fluent API for building a CompletionStage that supplies DittoHeaders for use within the RootRoute, with stepwise construction based on request context, query parameters, and custom headers.

classes.name: RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder
classes.description: Provides a fluent API for constructing DittoHeaders with stepwise methods, including nested classes for request context, query parameters, and final build step.

classes.name: RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder.RequestContextStep
classes.description: Step for setting the RequestContext and extracting headers.

classes.name: RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder.QueryParametersStep
classes.description: Step for setting query parameters and converting them into headers.

classes.name: RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder.BuildStep
classes.description: Final step that builds a CompletionStage of DittoHeaders, applying custom headers and size checks.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder with provided components.

methods.name: withInitialDittoHeadersBuilder
methods.description: Starts building with a pre-initialized DittoHeadersBuilder.

methods.name: withRequestContext
methods.description: Sets the RequestContext, extracts headers, and proceeds to query parameter step.

methods.name: withQueryParameters
methods.description: Sets query parameters, converts and adds headers, and checks for conflicts.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds a CompletionStage of DittoHeaders, applying custom headers and size validation.
